title: “Ra… Something Species.”
paragraphs: “I see, so that’s the nature of a Dragon Emperor. Could you explain it to me later?”
“I think that should be fine. However, please don’t let Wyndia-chan know about this. It seems to be part of Gaelion’s parenting policy.”
“That’s quite a complicated way of raising a child. Got it. This might also be useful for my research.”
The attending physician said that and accepted Father’s request. As expected of the attending physician. She’s very understanding.
“Now, this is more of a casual question, but does the Spear Hero who knows the future know what kind of research I’m doing?”
“I’ve heard about it from others, so yes, I do.”
I’ve heard it from Father and the Filolials.
“Your goal is to create the strongest monster that can be useful during the Waves, correct?”
“That’s a pretty intense goal!” Father said, looking at the attending physician.
Is that so surprising? If the Filolials wished to become stronger, I wouldn’t hesitate to aim for the strongest Filolial. So, I can understand the sentiment.
“…You’re not wrong. Yes, my dream is to improve the status of monsters and create powerful new species.”
“I’ve heard that you wanted to create monsters that could become as famous as Filolials or Dragons.”
“That’s not far off.”
“I remember grinding through things like that in games…”
Apparently, Father had cooperated quite a lot with the attending physician’s research. I believe the research had advanced considerably. In fact, back then, we had a well-established fighting force.
“So? What kind of things did I create in the future?”
“You were researching Bio-Plants together with Naofumi.”
“I was involved in such mad science…? I had only heard a brief summary.”
Father gave me a look as if he had just learned some shocking new fact. Had I not mentioned this before?
“I remember you were doing a lot of other things too.”
What was it again? I vaguely recall that the attending physician was researching various monsters that Father had created.
“And then, I’m pretty sure there was a new type of monster.”
“Hmm… what kind of monster? What was it called?”

The attending physician leaned forward, asking eagerly. I can recall the appearance, but the name is blurry in my memory. There were too many types, and I remember a lot of names, but I can’t recall them clearly.
“Ra… something species, I think.”
“Motoyasu-kun… you barely remember, huh…”
“I remember that Father created it. I believe its abilities were said to be on par with the Filolials.”

Was it modeled after Big Sister? It was created inside a massive Bio-Plant, like a castle, and took about a week to complete. I didn’t know much about it, but I remember it got along very well with the Filolials. Overall, it was supposed to be a very docile creature.
“I did? What kind of creature was it?”
“At first glance, it looked like a raccoon or a tanuki, but it could transform and become as strong as a bear. That’s how I remember it.”
“Hmm…”
“It was also able to master illusions. However, unlike the angelic Filolials… even including Rival, it never reached the point of human transformation.”
I tried sketching the creature that Father had created. Since it wasn’t a Filolial, my enthusiasm and drawing skill were a bit lacking.
“Wow, that’s a pretty cute design. Kind of like a yokai that lives next door.”
“I know that Father was quite fond of it. When Filo-tan saw how fondly Father treated that creature, she looked envious.”
“Now I feel kind of bad hearing that…”
Father beckoned Sakura-chan over and petted her. Sakura-chan looked very pleased.
“A creature like this, huh?”

“By the way, the attending physician’s cherished monster was also one of these. It could liquefy, reconfigure itself, and had remarkable versatility. I remember she even created a bio-tank independently.”

I recall it was used as a weapon for the larger Filolials. In that sense, she was quite a remarkable researcher. During the big battle with Takt, there were three main battlefields, and it played an active role in one of them.
“…Hmm, so you know about Mii-kun? Then maybe the story about coming from the future is true after all.”
“That being said, how did we even create something like that? I can’t even imagine it.”

At that time, Father had apparently been consumed by the Curse Series and had gone mad. The attending physician was astonished by the incredible feats he had achieved. Which is why it’s impossible now.
“Well, no point wishing for something that doesn’t exist. We probably don’t have the materials to make it happen anyway.”
“Yeah, I can’t even begin to figure it out.”
“Aside from the research results, I’d really like to know how I ended up meeting the Shield Hero.”
“I don’t know that much either.”
By the time I came to the village, the attending physician was already there. I don’t know much about the circumstances either.
“Did you just drop by my territory while doing some fieldwork?”
“I don’t think it was something like that, actually.”
“Then… there must be some other reason. Rat-san, do you have any idea? Maybe… any possibilities?”
“Let’s see… There’s an upcoming competition, or rather a contest, with the Homunculus Research Institute. But I doubt that’s the reason…”

Hmm, I can’t think of a reason why the attending physician came to Father’s territory from Faubrey. I can’t imagine why such an exceptional attending physician would leave Faubrey to come to Father’s still-developing territory.
“Wait, the Homunculus Research Institute? Didn’t Motoyasu-kun turn the pig of Faubrey—excuse me, the king—into one?”
“Oh! That’s right!”
“Ah… yes. The Homunculus Research Institute was shut down by the king’s orders, wasn’t it?”
The attending physician scratched her head in annoyance while looking off into the distance.
“There was a pretty talented kid over there. Not as good as me, but I used to enjoy competing with them every time…”
“Uh…” Father let out a slightly apologetic sigh.
But isn’t that a good thing? That was where Takt’s followers were lurking. They even created a fake Crimson Swine and faked his death. It’s only natural that it was shut down.
“During a joint research project a while back, that kid’s research had progressed far less than I expected. I was honestly disappointed.”
“That kid?”

“The one I acknowledged over at the Homunculus Research Institute. I used to look forward to competing with their research, but recently they’ve been too caught up in romance, so I gave them a stern warning.”
Romance? Father seemed to pick up on the same thing I was wondering about.
“I see. I think I’ve got a rough idea of what happened now.”
“Huh? What do you mean?”
“I think I’ve figured out how Rat-san ended up in my territory and why.”
Father nodded several times and then explained it to me and the attending physician.
“That kid… she’s a girl, right? And the person she was involved with… wasn’t it the Seven Star Whip Hero?”

“Oh? You figured that out pretty quickly. About half a year ago, I met that guy at Faubrey’s alchemy symposium. He was skeptical about my research, but at the same time, he made some overly flirtatious comments.”
“I thought so. Based on what Motoyasu-kun told me and imagining Takt’s actions…” Father muttered his thoughts aloud, piecing everything together.
Ah, I see it now. I’ve got a pretty good idea of what happened too.

“Since we confiscated Takt’s inventions, I can say this: most of them were military-related. And from what I hear about the future, Rat-san was creating bio-tanks. There’s no doubt that she would be seen as a potential threat as a researcher.”
“What? So I was kicked out just because of one word from the Whip Hero?”
“No. Knowing Takt, who gathered so many beautiful women around him, I’m sure he tried to woo Rat-san in some way.”
“Ah…”
The attending physician nodded knowingly. It seems like she had an idea.
“There was a period when he was visiting here quite frequently.”
“And while things were going well with that girl from the Homunculus Research Institute, once Rat-san started to gain the upper hand in the contest…”
Knowing Takt… It’s easy to imagine that he would use his power to forcibly drive the attending physician out.
